messages:
Jordan: deploy blocked in eu-canary: vuln scan flagged transitive lib @Maya can you weigh in? deploybot output: `vuln: CVE-2024-9999 score 6.8 transitive`

deploybot: canary deployment paused due to policy: vuln score >= 6.0; see logs: https://deploy.internal/redwood/rc8/logs (auto-paused)

Maya: looking. is this from a prod-only dependency or dev dep? do we have SBOM evidence? pinging @Lina from legal

Lina: need proof of signed provenance for that transitive package — either SBOM + cosign attestation or an explicit legal waiver. Otherwise we can't greenlight unblock for EU.

Sam: we're inside the change window (today 18:00-22:00 UTC). If we stall, some customers will be impacted. Can we do a regional carveout to route EU traffic to US while we fix? @Jordan

Jordan: yes we can technically route eu-canary -> us-east as a temporary fallback. that is a geo/regulatory change though; @Lina any emergency approval path for a timeboxed regional fallback?

Lina: legal can approve an emergency regional fallback if we provide: (1) short mitigation plan, (2) updated release notes mentioning the carveout, (3) a timeboxed rollback plan. post the short plan here and I can sign off.

Maya: I can produce the SBOM snippet + checksum grep in ~5m. initial look: appears transitive crate `fastjson-simd v0.3.1` brought in by internal-parser. I can also propose pin to v0.3.0 which doesn't have the vuln.

Kevin: pinning in prod is effectively a partial rollback for that artifact. if pin is trivial we can hotpatch and unpause canary quickly. if not, regional carveout + staged rollback next change window is safer.

Jordan: proposed plan: (A) Maya posts SBOM snippet and checksum in thread; (B) if we can produce attestation within 15m we attempt hotpatch/unpause; (C) otherwise Sam applies regional carveout (EU->us-east) + update release notes + set auto-rollback in 12h. Maya pls paste SBOM snippet.

Maya: here's SBOM snippet:
```
- package: fastjson-simd
  version: 0.3.1
  checksum: sha256:abcd1234ef567890...
  source: crates.io
  direct_dependency: internal-parser v2.4.1
```
No cosign attestation found for that transitive package. sending this to legal for review.

Lina: thanks. since there's no cosign for the transitive crate, I recommend we do the temporary regional carveout + pin plan. I approve emergency regional fallback under these conditions (mitigation plan + changelog entry + rollback window). @Sam please execute and update release notes.

Sam: :thumbsup: executing regional carveout now. routing rule: eu-canary -> us-east until 2025-03-21T02:30Z (timeboxed 12h). I'll add a release-note blurb and open a changelog PR referencing this thread.

deploybot: action: routing rule applied by @Sam. Canary traffic for rc8 in eu now routed to us-east. Tag: `carveout/eu->us-east/1768504322`

Jordan: thanks all. creating follow-up ticket for pin+hotpatch. if legal gets cosign later we can re-enable eu route immediately. will update thread with ticket link.
